## 1 — Graphic Standards Manual

**Introduced:** Week 1 — Aug 25 · **Due:** Sun Oct 18, 11:59 PM Eastern Time · **Weight:** 5%

**Present:** Four 17 x 11 inch pages in one PDF: template, typography, color/line styles and an applied sheet; editable layout and assets.

### Purpose

Design a reusable graphic system that makes all your course work read as one coherent collection.

### What you will learn

- Use color relationships, typography and hierarchy to organize information.
- Use alignment, spacing and composition to guide the reader.
- Build your own reusable template and apply it consistently.

### What to do

- Make four pages: sheet grid and composition; typography; color and line styles; an applied course sheet.
- Use 17 x 11 inch landscape pages. Show useful settings beside examples, including margins, type sizes and line weights.
- Choose up to two colors plus a white or dark background. Give either HEX or RGB values and explain the palette relationship, such as complementary or analogous. If starting from a triad, identify the two hues you retained.
- Keep the type hierarchy simple: no more than three typefaces, four hierarchy levels and four line weights.
- Study the reference manuals in Resources, credit one useful idea, and test the system on your own work. Apply it to every assignment and the final booklet.

### What to submit

- **Presentation:** exactly four 17 x 11 inch landscape pages in `Lastname_Firstname_GSM.pdf`, in the order below. No separate cover.
- **Page 1 - Sheet template:** show margins, columns, gutters, alignment and title/caption/footer positions; include a small layout example.
- **Page 2 - Typography:** show title, subtitle, body and caption examples with the typeface, size and spacing settings used.
- **Page 3 - Color and line styles:** show the palette, either HEX or RGB values, background choice and a short color-theory explanation. Apply the line weights to a drawing.
- **Page 4 - Applied sheet:** use your own course work to demonstrate composition, labels, captions and image treatment. Credit one useful idea from the reference manuals.
- **Editable files:** include the original layout/template and linked images in `Lastname_Firstname_GSM/`. Check that the PDF and packaged source reproduce the same four pages. Submit the revised manual separately with the final booklet.

### What we assess

- Visual quality and hierarchy 40%; consistency and usability 30%; tested applications 20%; completeness 10%.


**Ungraded checkpoints:**

- Week 2 — Sep 1: Bring a sample sheet for an ungraded identity check.
- Final review — December 10–16, 2026; exact review slot to be confirmed: Submit the revised manual as a separate PDF alongside the booklet.
